authorization: The agent may implement and deploy evidence-backed corrective changes without requesting a second approval when a confirmed error, bug, broken logic, missing technical control, corrupted data path, or execution defect is causing or is reasonably likely to cause avoidable capital loss or materially reduce realized profitability.
intent: Prevent or stop avoidable capital bleeding while preserving empirical validation, human strategy authority, and complete traceability.
authorized_without_additional_approval: pause or withhold new entries when a confirmed technical defect makes safe execution or attribution impossible
restore, replace, or verify a missing or incorrect reduce-only protective order without widening the operator-approved risk contract
close only the affected position reduce-only when exposure is unprotected, mis-sized, misrouted, duplicated, orphaned, or cannot be safely restored
correct symbol, side, provider, execution-plan, stop, target, timer, fee, funding, precision, reconciliation, or persistence logic so runtime behavior matches the already-approved configuration
correct stale, missing, corrupted, aliased, or contradictory market, order, position, portfolio, journal, or telemetry data that can impair execution or decision quality
repair retry, rate-limit, timeout, idempotence, restart-adoption, cache, logging, observability, and fail-closed behavior
restart or roll back an affected technical component when the change is required to load a verified corrective fix and the deployment boundary is safe
apply a minimal reversible technical correction that prevents a demonstrated implementation defect from reducing attainable profitability
not_authorized_without_specific_approval: change an alpha hypothesis, strategy family, or causal entry mechanism merely because recent PnL is disappointing
add or remove assets or execution routes for economic optimization rather than technical correctness
increase leverage, margin fraction, notional sizing, portfolio concentration, or venue risk
change a correctly implemented stop, target, profit lock, maximum hold, entry threshold, regime rule, or priority based only on modeled performance
silently retune parameters, select a backtest winner, promote an observer, or open a new live evidence window
treat ordinary variance, one loss, one missed move, or an unconfirmed hypothesis as a technical defect

required: direct reproduction or authoritative runtime contradiction
identified approved contract or invariant that current behavior violates
bounded causal path from the defect to capital safety or realized-profitability harm
minimal corrective delta with explicit rollback
tests that fail before the fix and pass after it when code changes are involved
current venue, position, order, profile, and process reconciliation before deployment
insufficient: backtest improvement without a reproduced implementation defect
readiness percentage or model conviction alone
a plausible but unverified failure theory

severity_and_response.P0_active_capital_incident: Stabilize immediately: stop new exposure, preserve or restore reduce-only protection, and close only affected unsafe exposure if protection cannot be verified. Then patch, test, reconcile, and report.
severity_and_response.P1_confirmed_capital_or_execution_defect: Implement and verify the minimal correction immediately; deploy at the earliest boundary that creates less expected technical risk than waiting.
severity_and_response.P2_noncritical_operational_or_telemetry_: Implement and stage the correction, then deploy at a verified flat/order-free or otherwise isolated safe boundary.
severity_and_response.economic_hypothesis: Research and present the complete approval proposal; standing technical authorization does not apply.

deployment_invariants: create or verify a recoverable prechange backup
preserve the active profile and risk contract except for the proven corrective field
fail closed on unresolved position, order, profile, account, or source identity
never print or persist wallet or API secrets
use reduce-only semantics for emergency exits or protective-order replacement
run focused regression, integration, configuration, and preflight checks proportional to the affected path
verify venue state and authoritative telemetry after deployment
journal the defect, evidence, exact change, tests, deployment time, outcome, confidence, and falsifier
report the action and current exposure to the operator immediately
rollback_triggers: position, order, profile, source, or accounting identity becomes unresolved
the patch changes strategy behavior outside the proven defect scope
new orders or exposure appear unexpectedly
backend health, latency, reconciliation, or protective-order state degrades
post-deployment evidence contradicts the causal diagnosis

checkpoint_epoch_cache.observed_effect: rolling checkpoint generation can lag and transiently consume high CPU and memory, making checkpoint-backed TUI panels appear stale
checkpoint_epoch_cache.capital_state: live backend remains healthy and the HYPE position is protected
checkpoint_epoch_cache.authorized_next_action: deploy the verified cache correction at the first safe flat/order-free transition, or earlier only if resource pressure becomes a material execution-health threat

entry_submission_freshness.status: corrective source is already loaded in the active v51 prestart bundle
entry_submission_freshness.authorized_next_action: continue telemetry validation; no duplicate deployment

active_HYPE_short.authorized_next_action: allow the frozen configured exit contract to manage the lifecycle; do not intervene solely because unrealized PnL fluctuates

falsifier: If the operator states that a category above was not intended to be preapproved, narrow the scope immediately. If a proposed correction cannot prove a violated technical invariant and causal harm path, classify it as an economic hypothesis and obtain specific approval.
